column3: Manami Route ・ Summer House-sitting
Kyousuke, watch the house while we're gone!
Roger that! Have fun on your trip!
Of course! Well then Dear, shall we?
Aaaah, *stretch*.
Soon after the manjuu incident...
Manami and I, we spent our days together, each one the same as the one before.
Yup. Going to and coming back from school together... As childhood friends.
With her casual giggles... and her meaningless chitchat...
How a word like "engaged" can blow things out of proportion.
But, yeah...
Yeah? Mom?
Wrong, Kyou-chan!
Oh, Manami? It's unlocked, just come on in.
Coming～
Geez, Kyou-chan, it's dangerous if you don't properly lock the door～
Hearing that coming from you... Don't you also leave it open most of the time?
That's because my house is also a shop～
Oh, that makes sense...
That's right～ Teeheehee...
Phew...
Hey hey, well you sure look right at home.
Ah... I-is that bad?
Why would it be?
Your sofa is just so comfortable.
Oh yeah?
Yeah. If I sit there when I'm tired, I'll probably fall right asleep... *yawn*
Are you saying you're tired?
Yes, just a little... This morning I helped with a special manjuu order...
Oh, good job.
Hehe, thank you.
Are your parents already gone?
Yeah, they left right before you came.
I see～. Seems like a lot of trouble, since it's so far away.
I guess.
Though, both of them seemed like they really looked forward to seeing Kirino-chan!
They also seemed delighted when talking to my mom!
Oh? Well, it's been a while since they were able to see her in person.
Hehe, I know, right? But are you fine not going?
Hm... I guess. I have to watch the house too.
Truthfully speaking, it's just a facade.
Obviously, my parents thought I would come. The whole "watching the house" thing came from me.
Kirino is doing her best on her side too.
Yeah, that's just how she is.
It's really impressive.
I didn't say anything to Manami.
Even our parents don't know. It's not like it's only a secret between me and Kirino, but...
Wa-wait, Kirino? W-What are you doing?
Can't you tell?
Can't I tell... Are you going on a trip?
A trip? Where would I go for a trip in this season?
Then what about this huge luggage...
I'm studying... abroad.
S-S-Say that again?!
I already got mom and dad's permission.
Wait! I never heard anything about you studying abroad!
...Why would I need to tell you?
It's not that you "need" to tell me but...
T-The heck happened?
Going abroad... That's way too sudden!
If you enter my room while I'm not here, I'll totally kill you.
I won't.
Not just you, okay?
Huh?
That plain girl definitely can't either.
That plain girl is really nosy. So it's obvious that she'll try to enter by saying something like "I'll do the cleaning".
To make sure it doesn't happen, it's your job to keep an eye on her.
H-Hey, wait a second! Are you saying that...
That the reason for your studying abroad is...
Ah, even an idiot like you figured it out, huh?
If the day ever comes where I have to call that plain girl "Older Sister", then I'll be leaving this family!
Ehhhhhh?!
And so, Kirino really left...
Her motive for doing so was quite odd. "When" she says... Well, it almost did happen but...
Wasn't that way too sudden? Once she's made up her mind on something though, there's no going back.
In fact, when she told me about it, all the preparations were already done.
*Zzzzzz*
Hm? Manami?
Gnnuu... I'm awake... Kyou... chan... *Zzzz*
She's asleep alright.
Gnn... *Zzzzzzzzzzzz*... Kyou-chan...
Yeah yeah, sleep tight.
Manami's sleeping face, grinning like an idiot eating something delicious... I wonder what she's dreaming about?
Well, no matter the dream, if it's Manami's it must be quite pleasant.
Ahhhh～. But I can't move with her in the way.
Empty... That word perfectly describes it.
Mom and Dad are gone, Kirino's not here either.
This has happened many times before. But why...
Kirino not being here, it's almost like something's missing.
...I guess I'm worried.
That annoying, sadistic girl that treats people like insects.
Why... does it feel like something's missing? I guess I should take this as a luxury.
Kyou-chan... it's delicious... here...
...Good grief.
Hmm... being with Kyou-chan... heehee... so happy... *Zzz*
I try patting Manami's sleeping head, and for some reason it soothes me.
Ah. That's it.
You win some, you lose some, is that it?
Kyou-chan...
Yes, good night.
*Zzz*
